images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a first-person horror memory game shot through a camera viewfinder. A cramped old apartment child's bedroom in one-point perspective, frozen in a harsh on-camera xenon flash: overexposed bright center falling off to pitch black at the edges, hard black drop shadows directly behind every object, cold cyan-white cast, slight chromatic aberration and heavy grain. Visible: faded damask wallpaper with a crack, a wooden wardrobe with a mirror door, an unmade bed, a family photo with one face scratched out, a wall clock, a desk with a red music box and tiny ballerina, a porcelain doll sitting on a chair staring into the lens, a rusty key on the floorboards, a film canister under the chair, a red rug. Monospace camera OSD: corner brackets, a large draining countdown timer, a checklist of items to find, flash charge pips, blinking REC. Korean UI text: "1초 스냅", "0.62초", "찾을 것", "녹슨 열쇠". HUD constraints: the "찾을 것" checklist lists exactly three items — "녹슨 열쇠", "오르골", "필름 통" — all unchecked (nothing has been found yet during the flash); the OSD shows no calendar date or year, only the countdown "0.62초".

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the same horror memory game after the flash is gone: near-total darkness. Only a very faint inverted negative afterimage of the bedroom floats in the black, cyan and magenta ghost outlines of the bed, wardrobe, desk and chair, blurred like a retinal afterimage. The chair where the doll sat is now empty black, and two tiny warm eye glints hover much closer to the camera on the floor. Glowing touch markers: a green ring over the music box marked found, a dashed red ring on empty floor marked a miss, and a pale rippling fingertip cursor groping near the floor. A red pulsing heartbeat ECG line crosses the lower screen, dim monospace OSD with elapsed time, item checklist 1 of 3, breath pips, and a trembling serif event line in the upper center. Korean UI text: "오르골 ✓", "00:17.40", "…오르골이 혼자 울리기 시작했다".
